messages:
sara-cs: Heads-up — Cust #389 opened a ticket: after we switched their reserved capacity pool, their embeddings now return the wrong length. They expect 1536 floats but are receiving 1530 for some batched requests. They say it started immediately after pinning to the reserved variant.

james-support: Can you paste the exact request/response they shared and which variant they pinned to?

sara-cs: Pasted from customer: ```POST /v1/embeddings
{ \"model\": \"open-embed-3-resv-quant8-2024-12-01\", \"input\": [\"hello\"] }```
Response: `{"embedding": [<1530 floats>], "metadata": {"embedding_dim": 1530}}`
They also ran a batched call and saw mixed lengths: single -> 1536, batch of 8 -> 1530.

miguel-ml: Interesting. That pattern (single OK, batched wrong) often points at packing/batching or quant-block alignment. Any infra changes in reserved pools around packing or postprocessing?

alice-eng: We did deploy a performance optimizer to reserved pools yesterday that changes quant packing behavior (reduces padding overhead). It should not change vector length, but I'll pull logs.

deploy-bot: deploy completed: reserved-capacity/quant-packing-optimizer @ 2024-12-01T12:34:01Z on us-east-1a

sara-cs: Customer pinned to `open-embed-3-resv-quant8-2024-12-01`. They repro steps: 1) call embeddings single -> len 1536. 2) call with batch size 3 -> got [1536,1536,1530]. 3) call with X-Disable-Batching header -> back to 1536s.

james-support: That header experiment is a great signal — suggests batching path is trimming or miscomputing tensor width. Does runtime ever drop trailing dims for int8 packing?

miguel-ml: I reproduced locally with the same pinned variant. Command I used: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' -d '{"model":"open-embed-3-resv-quant8-2024-12-01","input":["a","b","c"]}'```
Result: lengths [1536,1536,1530]. I attached a short dump of the runtime tensor shapes: final packed tensor shape on the third item was missing 6 columns.

alice-eng: Root cause analysis so far: during continuous batching we compute the number of quant blocks as `floor(tensor_width / quant_block)` in an optimization path. That should have been `ceil(...)` to preserve any partial block. For certain batch boundaries the floor op dropped trailing small remainder dims during a merge step after KV-cache compaction. That compressed the output dimension by `quant_block - remainder` for some items.

oncall-bot: incident created INC-2024-389-EMBED-DIM by miguel-ml

sara-cs: Customer asks for an immediate mitigation — they want stable embeddings now. Options?

miguel-ml: Workarounds: 1) Use the float variant `open-embed-3-fp32` or `open-embed-3-resv-fp16` for their pool. 2) Set header `X-Disable-Batching: true` to force per-request execution. 3) We can roll back the packing optimizer on their reserved pool. All three restore 1536.

alice-eng: I'm preparing a hotfix: change floor->ceil in packing calculation and add a guard to avoid dropping dims on merges. Patch will be deployed to us-east-1a first. ETA ~10m.

deploy-bot: hotfix job queued -> patch/quant-pack-rounding @ 2024-12-01T12:43:20Z

deploy-bot: hotfix applied to us-east-1a @ 2024-12-01T12:44:30Z (rolling restart nodes 1/3)

sara-cs: Confirmed with customer: after the hotfix, batched requests now return 1536 consistently. They unpinned and re-tested. Customer asked whether billing or token counts changed.

james-support: Billing unaffected — tokenization and token count unchanged; only internal packing changed. We should note this in the customer reply and include the workaround timeline.

miguel-ml: Postmortem notes: commit abc123 introduced the floor-based packing in an attempt to reduce padding overhead; missed unit tests for edge-case block remainders. Fix: replace floor->ceil, add unit tests for block-aligned and non-aligned tensor widths, and add integration tests exercising pinned variants with varied batch sizes. Also will add an alert when embedding_dim in response != model expected dim.

alice-eng: I'll add a changelog entry and tie this to INC-2024-389-EMBED-DIM. Also adding a shortcut in the console to force unpin to previous variant as a mitigation path for customers.

sara-cs: Customer is satisfied for now; they want the writeup and confirmation when the change lands in all reserved pools. Thanks everyone.
